text: US-TX-STD: Texas state plus local sales tax, 8.25% of the taxable subtotal, rounded half-up to the cent on the invoice subtotal.
US-FREIGHT-EXEMPT: separately stated interstate freight charges are not taxable; tax must be zero.
US-WA-SVC: Washington professional services tax, 7.25% of the subtotal, rounded half-up to the cent on the invoice subtotal.
US-PRINT-6: 6% sales tax on printed goods, computed on the invoice subtotal. Per-line rounding can differ by one cent and is a warning, not an error.
DE-VAT-STD: German standard VAT (Umsatzsteuer), 19% of the net amount.
UK-VAT-STD: UK standard-rate VAT, 20% of the net amount.
